decisions.reason: The firm launched the white-label test vinyl series only in 2024 and promoted it publicly on its website, so management will likely attribute any weak early sales to a temporary ramp-up phase and keep it in line with its vinyl-focused direction.

A compilation series takes licensing and curation investment, its later volumes build on the first, and it is publicly tied to the label's identity, so management will likely persist with it into 2025.
